summary: California Water Service Group filed an 8-K reporting the California Public Utilities Commission's final decision on its 2024 General Rate Case. The decision authorizes revenue increases of $90.5M (10.9%) in 2026, $43.2M (4.7%) in 2027, and $48.9M (5.1%) in 2028, and permits $1.45B in infrastructure investment through 2027. This is a routine regulatory rate case outcome, not a special situation. No deal terms are present. No further action or risk-arb angle exists.
